name: In the Year of the Dragon

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after scoring at the end of round 12, then final scoring

categories.label: Score track position before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: Marker position on the score track after round 12 (palaces, dragons on ladies/privileges, actions, festivals).

categories.label: Person tiles in palaces
categories.labelVi: Số nhân vật trong cung điện
categories.hint: 2 VP per person tile in your palaces.

categories.label: Monks (Buddhas x palace floors)
categories.hint: For each monk: Buddhas on it x floors of its palace; enter each monk's value.

categories.label: Remaining money
categories.hint: First sell all rice and fireworks tiles for 2 yuan each, then 1 VP per 3 yuan.

categories.label: Person track position (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí trên track nhân vật (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Higher/farther ahead on the person track wins ties.

tiebreakers.description: Marker farthest ahead on the person track

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Season/round scoring happens on the score track during play (1 VP per palace, per dragon on court ladies and privileges at each round end; events add more), so trackScore is read from the board before adding final scoring. Not verified against the official Alea/Ravensburger PDF; text taken from the RulesPal rulebook reproduction.
